Hadith.5882 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a group of people lifting a stone and said: "What is this and what drives you to do it?"
They replied: "So we may know who among us is the strongest and most powerful."
Prophet (sw) said: "Shall I not guide you to the strongest and mightiest among you?"
They said: "Yes, O' Messenger of Allah (swt)."

Prophet (sw) said: "The strongest and mightiest among you is the one who, when pleased, is not led by his pleasure into sin or falsehood, and when angry, his anger does not drive him away from speaking the truth, and when he possesses power, he does not take what is not rightfully his."

In another narration, Prophet (sw) added:
"And when he has authority, he does not claim what is not his by right."
